targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(cost_usd), 4) FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime
SELECT sum(total_tokens) FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime
SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(latency_ttft_ms), 1) FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime
SELECT round(sum(is_fallback) / count(), 4) FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_timestamp, INTERVAL 5 SECOND) AS time, quantile(0.50)(latency_total_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_total_ms) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(latency_total_ms) AS p99 FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_timestamp, INTERVAL 5 SECOND) AS time, model_served, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time, model_served ORDER BY time

SELECT virtual_key_id, organization_id, count() AS requests, sum(is_fallback) AS fallbacks, sum(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tok, sum(completion_tokens) AS compl_tok, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tok, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS spend_usd, round(avg(latency_ttft_ms), 1) AS avg_ttft_ms, quantile(0.99)(latency_total_ms) AS p99_latency_ms FROM ai_gateway.request_telemetry WHERE event_timestamp >= $__fromTime AND event_timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY virtual_key_id, organization_id ORDER BY spend_usd DESC LIMIT 20
